name: HH regime-switch 06 — realized-vol CONTRACTION regime → trade mean-reversion (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM (the contraction LEG of the vol-regime switch, the mirror of variant 04): in a low realized-vol contraction regime price oscillates around a stable mean because market-maker inventory rebalancing dominates and there is no directional flow. You FADE that liquidity provider by buying statistical dips. This spec ONLY trades reversion, and ONLY when vol_realized is in its lower regime (below a fitted contraction ceiling) so it never fades a genuine trend. Entry: vol_realized low AND price washed down (bb_z below a fitted floor) AND rsi oversold. Exit: bb_z reverts up through zero (mean recovered) or vol_realized breaks UP out of the contraction band (regime flip — stop fading), or stop/TP/time. Pairs with 04 to form the switch. DISCONFIRMER: reversion's edge in the BOTTOM realized-vol tercile must independently clear the Gate net of fees; if it only survives pooled with the expansion leg, the switch is a curve-fit label. Kill if the contraction ceiling has to be re-fit per-asset — a real regime uses one global threshold. Also kill if an unconditional bb_z dip-buy (no vol gate) matches the deflated Sharpe: then the vol regime adds nothing.
catalyst: low realized-vol contraction with a washed-out dip — a market-maker mean to fade
